pad_marker_displacement — DRIVE pegtactile op

• Data kinds: scalar × signal × table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.pad_marker_displacement(P: 'float', q_uv, pad: 'dict', ctx=None, pts=None, torsion: 'float' = 0.0, torsion_model: 'str' = 'partial_slip') -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import pegtactile; pegtactile.pad_marker_displacement(P: 'float', q_uv, pad: 'dict', ctx=None, pts=None, torsion: 'float' = 0.0, torsion_model: 'str' = 'partial_slip') -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("pad_marker_displacement"))

Usage

Membrane surface displacement at the marker positions (closed form + Cerruti convolution): shear |q| in direction φ is the x-direction Mindlin field rotated by φ, u(p) = R(φ) u_x(R(−φ)p) (the kernel is an isotropic half-space, so it is closed under rotation); the radial displacement ūr of the normal load (Johnson eq. 3.41b) and the torsion field are added. The torsion field is partial slip if torsion_model="partial_slip" (default, since 2026-10-06) (numerical solution of cuttouch.torsion_partial_slip, slipping from the edge annulus), or the no-slip field used up to 0.4.0 if "no_slip" (tactorque.torsion_stick_field). When the torsion exceeds full slip, the membrane cannot carry any more torsion, so the field of the table's last row (stick circle = 1 annulus) is drawn and the torsion_slipping flag is set. pts are the marker centers (px; if omitted, the reference positions in ctx). Returns u_m (N, 2) [m], hz, mp (Hertz and Mindlin tables), phi, Q, torsion, torsion_model, torsion_ratio, torsion_slipping. Full slip (|q| ≥ μP) is flagged by mp['slipping'] (field with c = 0). Raises ValueError: P ≤ 0 (pad not in contact), q is not 2 finite components, misspelled torsion_model.
